{'translation': 'This year officially became the year of super apps. OpenAI recently launched its own super app and admitted that the app is "a bit of a mess." Now the CEO of Microsoft has also confirmed that a super app for Copilot is coming soon.', 'raw_translation': '今年正式成為超級應用程式之年。OpenAI 近日推出自家嘅超級應用程式，仲承認個 app「有啲亂晒大龍」。而家微軟行政總裁亦確認，即將為 Copilot 推出超級應用程式。'}

{'translation': 'Microsoft Copilot "super app" will integrate Cowork, chat, coding and other features', 'raw_translation': '微軟 Copilot「超級應用程式」將整合 Cowork、聊天、編碼等功能'}

{'translation': 'Microsoft is developing an AI "super app" that combines Copilot chat, coding, and agent capabilities. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said at Wednesday\'s earnings call that the app will cover "consumer and business experiences" and will launch within this year. Nadella said: "Copilot is rapidly evolving from chat to Cowork to Autopilots. This quarter we will integrate these Copilot experiences along with coding features into a single super app... This is a major step, and I look forward to sharing more details with you later."', 'raw_translation': '微軟正研發一個結合 Copilot 聊天、編碼及代理能力嘅人工智能「超級應用程式」。微軟行政總裁 Satya Nadella 喺星期三嘅業績電話會議上表示，該應用程式將會涵蓋「消費者同商業體驗」，並喺今年內推出。Nadella 話：「Copilot 正在由聊天快速演進到 Cowork 再到 Autopilots。本季我哋會將呢啲 Copilot 體驗連同編碼功能整合喺同一個超級應用程式之內……呢係重大一步，我期待稍後同大家分享更多細節。」'}

{'translation': 'OpenAI\'s process of launching its own "super app" has already turned into a mess, but this clearly has not deterred other companies from following the super app route.', 'raw_translation': 'OpenAI 推出自家「超級應用程式」嘅過程已經變成一團糟，但呢顯然無阻其他公司採用超級應用程式嘅路線。'}

{'translation': "Or perhaps Microsoft can more successfully deliver a one-stop app and avoid repeating OpenAI's mistakes.", 'raw_translation': '或者微軟能夠更成功咁交付一個一站式應用程式，避免重蹈 OpenAI 嘅覆轍。'}

{'translation': 'That said, CEO Satya Nadella previously stated that the company is gradually reducing its reliance on apps and shifting its focus to developing agents. The era of AI is still very new, and the trends and best practices surrounding AI interfaces are still constantly evolving.', 'raw_translation': '話雖如此，行政總裁 Satya Nadella 早前亦曾表示公司正逐步減少對應用程式嘅依賴，轉為專注發展代理程式。人工智能嘅時代仍然好新，圍繞人工智能介面嘅趨勢同最佳實踐都仲喺不斷變化之中。'}

{'translation': 'As for Apple, there is currently no sign of it adopting the super app direction, and it continues to launch individual dedicated apps. Whether this strategy will change in the future is something worth keeping an eye on.', 'raw_translation': '至於 Apple 方面，就暫時未見有跡象採用超級應用程式嘅方向，反而繼續不斷推出個別嘅專門應用程式。呢個策略會唔會喺將來改變，將會係一件值得留意嘅事。'}

{'translation': 'What are your thoughts on this recent "super app" trend? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.', 'raw_translation': '你對呢個近期嘅「超級應用程式」潮流有咩睇法？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅意見。'}
